title: Algebraization over a fixed Chow modification
statement: Let A be a commutative Noetherian I-adically complete ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], Z Noetherian, and f : Z → Spec A separated and of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let Q = I O_Z and G be a coherent formal Q-module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] whose degree-zero support is proper over A [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Given a proper q : Y → Z, a natural number n, an immersion e : Y → ProjectiveSpace (ULift (Fin (n+1))) (Spec A), an equation identifying its projection with q followed by f, and an ideal sheaf L on Z with nonempty support complement over which q is an isomorphism, there exists a coherent module F on Y [pqf-def-coherent], an isomorphism from the tensor pullback of G to the Q.comap q completion of F, and proper support over A of q_*F.

source.place: Theorem 088E, paragraphs 2--4 (closed quotient, Chow modification, projective algebraization and proper push-pull comparison); verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/088E

proof.text: The supplied immersion e, and the equation he over Spec A, give the required quasi-projective structure on Y. Properness of q and Noetherianity of Z imply Y is Noetherian. Thus e is quasi-compact. Its scheme-theoretic image in the supplied finite projective space is a closed subscheme Y', projective over A, and e factors as an open immersion j : Y → Y' followed by the closed immersion into that projective space. Pull G back termwise along q. FormalSystemsPullback gives coherence and compatibility with the powers and quotient transitions of Q.comap q, which hQ identifies with I O_Y. The finite-type support pullback equality and Nakayama identify every term's support with q⁻¹ Supp(G₀). This closed set is proper over A by properness of q and hR. Its image under j is closed in the separated scheme Y' and proper over A. Extend each pulled term by j_*: on j(Y) it is the original coherent term, and on the complement of its closed support it is zero. These two opens cover Y'; coherence and the formal quotient compatibility can be checked there. The extension therefore defines a coherent formal I O_Y' system. Apply projective existence to the closed embedding of Y' into the projective space specified by e, obtaining a coherent F' and its completion isomorphism. The support of F' outside j(Y) is closed in the proper Y', so its image in Spec A is closed. If nonempty, it meets V(I), since completeness puts I in the Jacobson radical. At a point over V(I), Nakayama identifies support of F' with that of F'/IF', which is the extended degree-zero term and has support contained in j(Y). This excludes boundary support. Restrict F' along j to obtain F and restrict the completion isomorphism; the pullback/completion comparison identifies it with the requested system isomorphism. The support of F is proper over A because it is the support of F' transported into Y. Proper coherent pushforward along q is coherent, with support contained in the closed image of this support. That image is proper over A, and its closed subsets are proper, which proves the asserted proper support of q_*F. The construction uses e and he to obtain Y'; it does not presume a projective compactification for an arbitrary proper q.

theorem exists_chow_algebraization_data
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] (f : Z ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (Q : Z.IdealSheafData)
    (hQ : Q = (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Z Q)
    (hR : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (G.obj.obj (op 0)))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y ⟶ Z) [IsProper q] (n : ℕ)
    (e : Y ⟶ ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) (Spec (.of A)))
    [IsImmersion e]
    (he : e ≫ (ProjectiveSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A)) =
      q ≫ f)
    (L : Z.IdealSheafData)
    (hL : (L.support.compl : Set Z).Nonempty)
    (hIso : IsIso (pullback.snd q (Scheme.Opens.ι L.support.compl))) :
    ∃ F : CoherentModules Y,
      Nonempty (G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q ≅
        formalCompletionSystem (Q.comap q) F.obj) ∧
      Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj F.obj)
